name: SInput Gamepad
notes: 139-byte descriptor. Source: HandHeldLegend/SINPUT-LIB-HID sinput_lib_hid.c at 8dd1e5a (MIT-0), with its VID, PID and bcdDevice. Input report 0x01 is the pad, 63 bytes after its ID, which a consumer submits through SubmitRawReport. Output report 0x03 03 02 is SDL's features command, answered with input report 0x02, 64 bytes, as sinput_lib_protocol.c builds it. Bytes 20 to 25 are the serial SDL reads, the last one the controller's index. The answer sets rumble and leaves player LEDs and RGB clear, so SDL sends neither a player LED nor a color. OutputDecoded carries leftMotor and rightMotor from a type 2 haptics write (bytes 3 and 5) and from a type 1 write (the louder amplitude's high byte per side).

layout.note: Hand Held Legend's SInput protocol, which SDL reads through its HIDAPI SInput driver. The consumer packs report 0x01.
